verdict: Leads up 25% this week; Meta efficiency holding as volume scales.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 131 leads from Meta at a cost of $10.78 per lead — and that cost per lead dropped a further 3.6% this week even as daily spend rose 20%, meaning the campaigns are getting more efficient as they grow. Your Google Business Profile added 168 organic actions (52 calls, 81 direction requests) at no additional cost, supporting overall lead volume. Search click volume is down about 32% week-over-week with no paid search running, so that channel has no backstop right now; we're addressing that as part of attribution and channel setup work in progress. Your pipeline intake tracking had a brief connectivity issue this week, so the leads-to-appointments view is temporarily incomplete — that is being resolved and is not affecting lead delivery itself.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days via Meta ads
cost per lead this period, down 3.6% from the prior week
organic actions from your Google Business Profile (calls, directions, site clicks) — no ad spend attached

watch_item.issue: Search visibility is thinning — organic search clicks fell 32% week-over-week with no paid search active to offset the drop.
watch_item.fix: Phone-match attribution and channel credentials are being finalized this week, which clears the path to reactivating paid search coverage.
